label: Carbon & Ice
description: Carbon-black studio darkness with an ice-blue accent. Built for premium car detailing, ceramic coating and PPF, where the work is gloss and reflection and a dark page makes the cars the brightest thing on screen.
notes: Tokens only. On a DARK theme the text colours are LIGHTENED until they clear 4.5:1 on the background — the opposite of the light-theme fix. `secondary` and `border` sit deliberately close to `bg` because they are elevation, not text; do not "fix" their contrast. `accent` is what the renderer paints 12px meta text with in ~15 places, so it is the one that must never be darkened back toward the original hue. Shipped octane fails this test (primary 3.74:1 on bg), which is why this exists.
